title: Brain Gateway
description: Full application telemetry for Brain Gateway — the single canonical app dashboard (merged from the former Overview + SRE + Deep Dive). Every metric in orchestrator/metrics.py is covered here, grouped by subsystem. Infra lives in the Homelab Infrastructure dashboard. Use filters at the top to drill into a specific tool, mode, speaker, or palace wing. Paste a request_id into the text variable to trace a single request end-to-end in the logs row. Generated — edit monitoring/grafana/dashgen/dashboards/brain_gateway_sre.py, not the JSON.

panels.title: Request Latency (p50 / p95 / p99) by Mode
Chat TTFT (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Time to first streamed token on /v1/chat/completions. If this collapses toward Request Latency, streaming has silently degraded to the buffered path — cross-check the degradation panel.

panels.title: Stream Degradation Events (/min)
panels.description: Non-happy streaming outcomes (happy path is uncounted; denominator is the TTFT count). died_mid_emission = the user got a truncated answer.

panels.title: Truncated Answers (died_mid_emission, 24h)
panels.description: Streams that died after emitting → user saw a silently truncated reply. Watched by the ChatStreamTruncating alert.

panels.title: Empty Model Replies (/min)
panels.description: Rounds where the brain returned no text and no tool call. retried = re-asked once with thinking on; recovered = the retry answered; still_empty = the user got a blank. A sustained retried rate (>5% of voice turns) means the voice no-think fast path no longer pays off.

panels.title: Blank Replies (still_empty, 24h)
panels.description: Turns where the user got no answer even after the retry. Watched by the EmptyRepliesReachingUsers alert.

panels.title: Voice Pipeline Latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Text-in to text-out latency for voice-channel requests. Covers the LLM + tool-loop slice we control; excludes Whisper STT upstream and TTS synthesis + speaker playback downstream. Target: keep p95 under 13s (prior floor). Investigate spikes with the logs row below.

panels.title: TTS Latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Successful TTS round-trips to Qwen3-TTS on Helios :8002, from the dashboard chat's /api/tts/synthesize (one call per spoken sentence) and the /v1/audio/speech proxy (OWUI, stopped). Failures are NOT in this histogram — see Dashboard TTS Outcomes. Excludes browser playback. Both paths prepend ~150ms of silence against first-word stutter (TTS_SILENCE_PAD_MS).

panels.title: Dashboard STT Outcomes
panels.description: Per-utterance /api/stt/transcribe results per minute (mic button + hands-free call). A high share of 'empty' means the call-mode voice detector is false-triggering on room noise; unreachable = Helios asleep.

panels.title: Dashboard TTS Outcomes
panels.description: Per-sentence /api/tts/synthesize results per minute. unreachable = Helios asleep (chat shows 'Jess's voice is asleep'); timeout = TTS awake but stuck; upstream_error = TTS returned an error.

panels.title: Tool Call Delivery (native vs rescued vs dropped)
panels.description: How tool calls arrived from the model. 'dropped' is user-visible breakage — a <tool_call> marker was present but nothing parsed, so the agentic loop ended the turn early. It is the signal for the vLLM<0.20.0 qwen3 reasoning-parser defect (fixed upstream in PR #35687). 'xml_fallback' is a recovered call and is NOT expected to fire for that defect. Low traffic: allow weeks before reading a trend, and do not read an early zero as 'not happening'.

panels.title: code_agent Preflight vs Helios (1h)
panels.description: code_agent runs skipped because the code model endpoint was unreachable at preflight. Skips while 'helios running' is 0 are EXPECTED (Helios asleep). Skips while it is 1 mean Helios is powered but the code model endpoint is dead — the user then gets a misleading 'wake Helios' message and it needs investigation.

panels.title: Expert Calls by Result
panels.description: ask_expert tool delegates hard reasoning to Qwen3-32B Thinking on Saturn 3090 (10.0.0.58:8084). 30-150s latency is normal for full reasoning passes. Circuit breaker opens after N consecutive failures (EXPERT_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_FAILURES, default 3); the stat goes red.

panels.title: Task Flow (created / completed / dropped)
panels.description: The durable to-do list (state_store tasks table). Distinct from Task Decomposition above (ephemeral step-tracking) and Reminders (time-based). 'Open Tasks' is a live gauge, primed on startup and updated on every add/complete/drop. A steadily climbing open count with little completion is the backlog-graveyard smell the Sunday review job is meant to catch.

panels.title: Work calendar sync age
panels.description: Age of the last iPhone work-calendar (Exchange) push. No data = the work Shortcut has never synced.

panels.title: Vision Latency p95 + Image Size p95
Delivery Outcomes (/day)
panels.description: Rolling 1-day totals. Failed = every channel exhausted; missed = found >24h past due at startup.

panels.title: TTS by Speaker (success vs fail, /h)
panels.description: Per-speaker announcement health — a failing speaker group shows up here before anyone notices missed audio.

panels.title: Media: voice / photo / reply (6h)
panels.description: Inbound voice (STT) + photo (vision) + spoken voice_reply (TTS) outcomes. voice/result=stt_unreachable is expected when Helios is asleep; tts_failed / vision_failed / send_failed are actionable.

panels.title: Button Taps: Done / Snooze (6h)
panels.description: Done/Snooze/selfcare taps. ack/snooze result=not_found or a flat rate while reminders fire points at taps not landing (the 'Done didn't stick' class).

panels.title: Nudge Heartbeat Age (T-30)
panels.description: Seconds since the T-30 screens-away nudge job last fired. Fires nightly; > 25.5h (orange) means the scheduler dropped a rung. Also alerts (WindDownNudgeStale, quiet Pushover) since a missing spoken nudge is invisible in the house. NOT seeded at startup (as of 2026-07-08): 'No data' means the job hasn't fired since the last restart, or wind-down is disabled — the gauge only stamps on a real run.

panels.title: Dim Heartbeat Age (T-60)
panels.description: Seconds since the T-60 lights-dim job last fired. Ticks nightly regardless of whether it attempted a scene, so an orange here means the scheduler dropped ONLY the dim rung while the Scene Outcomes panel would otherwise stay silently empty. No alert watches this rung — a failed dim is self-evident in the house. NOT seeded at startup: 'No data' means the dim job hasn't fired since the last restart, or wind-down is disabled.

panels.title: Scene Outcomes (T-60 lights, /day)
panels.description: Rolling 1-day scene activations by outcome (ok | failed | error). The forensic answer to 'lights didn't dim last night'.

panels.title: Scene Failures (7d)
panels.description: Green 0 alongside an empty Scene Outcomes panel means the T-60 rung isn't attempting scenes (WIND_DOWN_SCENE unset, or the job isn't firing) — not that scenes are healthy.

panels.title: Budget Sync Age
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful Actual Budget sync (every ACTUAL_SYNC_INTERVAL, default 30 min). 'No data' means no success since the orchestrator last started, or the sync is not configured — check Budget Sync Outcomes and GET /api/finance/sync/status (last_error).

panels.title: Budget Sync Outcomes (/h)
panels.description: ok | error | busy per hour. 'busy' = a manual sync or the settings page overlapped a running one (harmless); sustained 'error' with no 'ok' triggers BudgetSyncFailing.

panels.title: Meal Plan Generations (/d)
panels.description: ok | retry_ok (first reply unusable, retry worked) | invalid | llm_error | asleep (Helios off) | error (bug — check logs) | interrupted.

panels.title: Meal Plan Latency
panels.description: Whole-plan generation (thinking on, waits for chat to go idle first) and single-meal swaps. Long plans hold the one model slot.

panels.title: Brain Queue (llama-server)
panels.description: Requests waiting for / using the single primary slot. 'deferred' > 0 means chat or a background job (plan, scan, auto-learn) waited. No data = Helios asleep.

panels.title: Pantry Scans & Swaps (/d)
panels.description: Photo stock-takes (proposed/empty/failed/committed/discarded) and meal swaps.

panels.title: Receipt Lines (/7d)
panels.description: How receipt lines were matched: matched_alias (a correction Jess remembered — should grow over time), matched_inventory, new, non_food.

panels.title: Scan Latency p95 by Kind
panels.description: Photo stock-takes and receipts, end to end (all photos of a scan, one at a time).

panels.title: Cooked & Portions Eaten (/7d)
panels.description: Meals marked cooked — planned prep/dinner or an off-plan meal (slot=other); dashboard / chat / push = reminder Done — and prepped portions eaten. source=undo is the mis-tap rate.

panels.title: Cooking Reminder Done + Fridge Check (/30d)
panels.description: Done taps on cooking reminders: unlinked = reminder from before phase 4, refused = plan replaced. Weekly fridge-check nudges. Items/batches the daily expiry pass retired.

panels.title: Pantry Decay Heartbeat Age
panels.description: Seconds since the 04:15 expiry pass last completed (re-seeded from the DB at startup, so a restart doesn't hide a dead job). If it stops, the morning 'use today' line goes stale. No data = it hasn't completed since the feature was deployed.

panels.title: Training Corpus New Records (daily, by source)
panels.description: Nightly training-corpus drain: in-process counter only — records written by the out-of-process manual backfill are not counted here. A flat-zero series on days you used Jess via OWUI / voice means the drain broke; investigate via the logs row.

panels.title: Scheduler Missed Jobs (by family, /day)
panels.description: Jobs APScheduler dropped after their 300s misfire grace lapsed during an event-loop stall. One-shot families (reminder, focus) are lost permanently — there is no runtime re-schedule. Any bar here is a dropped job; 0/flat is healthy.

panels.title: Missed Jobs (7d)
panels.description: Total scheduler jobs dropped in the last 7 days across all families. Non-zero = the event loop stalled past the misfire grace and silently discarded work.

panels.title: Missed Jobs (by family, total)
panels.description: Cumulative drops per family since orchestrator start. Which family is being lost points at where to look first.

panels.title: Self-Audit Heartbeat Age
panels.description: Seconds since the daily self-audit last completed a run (ok, partial or failed). > 25.5h (orange) = SelfAuditStale. 'No data' = self-audit disabled (SELF_AUDIT_ENABLED / JESS_ADVANCED).

panels.title: Self-Audit Runs (by result, /day)
panels.description: ok = logs read + diagnosed; partial = logs read, Helios asleep so no LLM diagnosis (healthy); failed = Loki unreachable/empty (2 in 2d with no ok/partial = SelfAuditFailing). A run of partials means the audit never gets a diagnosis.
